head: 9ff67f63e889907dd4cd48df7c2714ebe8fa611c
title: Send texts from a dedicated sender number
reason: The sender is read from one setting, a missing number refuses the text instead of sending it, and the one new column has a default.

risks.title: Texts stop until the number is set
risks.impact: Production refuses every text from the deploy until `SMS_SENDER_NUMBER` reaches the API pod.
risks.guard: The production overlay sets it in the same change.

risks.title: Outbox writes fail until the migration runs
risks.impact: A message saved between the API rollout and the migration fails to save.
risks.guard: The deploy runs migrations right after the rollout.

ticketFit.summary: Both criteria are in the code; neither has a test that sends a text.

criteria.text: Texts come from the dedicated number
A text with no sender number is refused

areas.name: Database
areas.summary: Adds `outgoing_messages.sms_sender_brand`, a text column with a default, so existing rows need no backfill.

facts.text: One added column, NOT NULL with a default

rows.label: Staging
rows.text: Staging has no sender number, so it sends no texts. Every step runs in production.

rows.label: Partner texts
rows.text: No screen sends a partner text yet. ACME-44 adds one; steps 2 and 3 wait for it.

items.context: Admin, production: Outbox in the menu
items.text: The day after the deploy, open Outbox and look at the chart along the top.
items.expect: Texts keep going out as on other days, with no quiet gap since the deploy.

items.context: Admin, production: a customer at an acme practice
items.text: Send a test text to your own mobile.
items.expect: It arrives from +61 400 000 000, not from the name ACME.

items.context: Admin, production: a customer at a partner practice
items.text: Try to send a test text to your own mobile.
items.expect: Nothing is sent. You see an error naming the partner, and no text arrives.

items.text: Confirm the SMS account behind production's `SMS_API_KEY` owns +61 400 000 000.
Deploy as usual with `bin/deploy-production.sh`, then check that `./migrate` finished.
Confirm the production API pod's environment has `SMS_SENDER_NUMBER`, from `api-config`.
Set the two `*_partner_production` variables in `terraform.tfvars.json`, then `terraform apply`.
Redeploy with `bin/deploy-production.sh`, so the API pods read the new secret.

rows.label: API start
rows.text: Unaffected. The new settings have no default and no start-up check.

rows.label: Acme texts
rows.text: With `SMS_SENDER_NUMBER` missing, a text is refused when it is queued.

parts.title: Terraform variables
parts.note: set in `terraform.tfvars.json`, all default to empty
